cfg.raw_spark: An app for one-man trade businesses who forget to chase unpaid invoices until the money is a problem.

answers.m2: I would build a Supabase table of bookings with a webhook that flags cancellations and auto-generates the deposit invoice before the date frees up.
answers.m3: My friend Owen, another wedding DJ, told me last month he started requiring signed contracts after a similar cancellation dispute.
answers.m4: Priya, a wedding florist I met through a vendor group, keeps a deposit tracking spreadsheet too. For her the pain is last-minute order changes, the deposit part is fine.
answers.m5: Daan uses a plain email thread to track bookings and cancellations, but nothing flags when a cancellation actually happens, so he has to notice it himself.
answers.m6: What she basically means is that the admin side makes her feel unprofessional.
answers.m7: Jordan only DJs corporate events booked through an agency on annual contract. Cancellations never cost him anything because the agency guarantees the booking.
